scope: Diagnostic registered equality AIR (128 rows) and twelve-key empty recursive proofs (2048 rows). No user transactions or wallet proving.
timing_scope: Proof elapsed_ns comes from each successful block_v2_registered_program report: witness generation plus prover invocation. Registration, test CPU reference work, verification, process launch and setup are excluded. Process timings include those costs and correctness checks.
limitations: Strict GPU-only policy is not selected; compatible policy enables all supported GPU path flags.
No transactions/minute estimate and no comparison to historical full-size timings.
GPU cache may already be warm; a new process does not imply a cold driver cache.
Stage wall spans overlap. Device events do not form an additive wall-time breakdown.
Managed allocator watermarks do not measure physical VRAM peaks.
One warm-up process and three measured processes per case; results are exploratory.

resource_notes: Peak RSS is the test process and its children from getrusage; it is not the whole-service cgroup memory peak.
No physical VRAM peak sampler was enabled for these short measurements.
Four Rayon threads and a 400% CPU quota intentionally bound the diagnostic; this is not a full-host throughput measurement.
interpretation: The selected GPU path completes and CPU-verifies the bounded fixtures.
The complete registered proof medians are 214-218 ms for 128 rows and 378-425 ms for 2048-row empty recursion.
These fixtures do not establish transaction-bearing wrapper, 64-input solving latency, strict GPU-only completion, or CPU/GPU speedup.
The compact empty fixture has a lower observed proof median in this small sample; whole-process medians are essentially equal. No default promotion is justified.
